title: Golden artifact serialization fixture
objective: Persist baseline displacement and load-displacement outputs from reference solvers as golden files for snapshot testing.
implementation_steps: Run elastic reference (P1.1) and capture displacement fields
Run plastic reference (P1.2) and capture load-displacement curves
Serialize outputs to golden/ directory in reproducible format (numpy .npz or JSON)
Implement snapshot comparison test in test_artifacts.py
Verify tests detect intentional drift when golden files are perturbed
acceptance_criteria: Golden snapshot tests pass for both elastic and plastic references
Intentional perturbation of golden files causes test failure (drift detection)

cases: Reference output matches golden to tolerance

risks: Platform-dependent floating point may cause golden drift — use tolerance-based comparison
